Gene-expression mean width reduction versus PPI++ is 5.693037791600409 percent; it is narrower than all three references. All six other conditions have strictly positive paired width-difference intervals versus PPI++.
Frozen-method condition-wise coverage ranges from 0.95 to 0.98; all simultaneous lower endpoints are below 0.95. No point estimate or qualification establishes a finite-sample coverage theorem.

Final assessment completed, with outcome qualified and no recorded failures; scientific-validity value zero is conservative non-certification, not evidence of a diagnosed coverage or adaptivity failure.
Final assessment: 400 seeds 1000 through 1399, seven conditions, nominal coverage 0.95, 128 labeled observations and 8192 unlabeled scores per condition; all methods have paired inputs.

Stored reporting protocol: simultaneous Clopper-Pearson coverage bounds over seven conditions and four methods; 512 paired bootstrap resamples with random seed 79231 and width comparison quantiles at 0.05/42 and 1-0.05/42.

Synthetic targets: linear and uninformative 0.5, nonlinear 0.1+0.8/3, rare outcome 0.01+0.08/3. Constant and permuted controls reuse nonlinear outcomes; constant scores equal 0.5. Gene-expression target is the mean of the final unique-record empirical source, not external biological truth.

Reported main estimand is ratio of mean widths; secondary per-repetition ratio aggregate is capped at 100 and is not interpreted as a percentage width increase. Five rare-outcome PPI++ intervals have zero width.

Selected readable source uses K=min(5,floor(n/2)) outer folds, three shared inner folds, zero/affine/nonlinear selection, and no unlabeled values in fitting or selection. The selection record identifies the inspected source location; source content, not the score or tree digest, supports these details. Independently verified byte identity to the final frozen tree is not asserted.

Nonlinear basis contains linear, quadratic and positive-part terms at normalized knots -0.5, 0, 0.5; diagonal ridge penalties 0.1, 2, 4, 4, 4; training quantiles 0.1, 0.9; binary calibrations clipped before signed multiplier. The selection record identifies the inspected source location; source content, not the score or tree digest, supports these details. Independently verified byte identity to the final frozen tree is not asserted.

Finite-N multiplier uses covariance divided by (1+n/N) times control variance; inner criterion adds residual variance and n/N times control variance; paired excess-risk plus one standard error must be negative. The selection record identifies the inspected source location; source content, not the score or tree digest, supports these details. Independently verified byte identity to the final frozen tree is not asserted.

Returned moments center residuals within folds and take the variance of the weighted combined controls on the shared unlabeled pool, including cross-fold covariance. The selection record identifies the inspected source location; source content, not the score or tree digest, supports these details. Independently verified byte identity to the final frozen tree is not asserted.

Student critical value has max(2,n-6) degrees of freedom; binary endpoints are clipped; constant scores and binary counts with fewer than ten successes or failures use label-only inference.
